summary: Frontend-only verification of Casa Güell trilingual site (CA/ES/EN), new dish photos, and mobile hero video fix. All requested features verified working. Trilingual switching perfect on desktop + mobile: hero phrase, nav, section headings, menu tabs, dish names/descriptions render correctly in all 3 languages with zero 'undefined' occurrences anywhere in DOM. English content matches spec exactly (hero='Catalan tradition, with nothing to hide'; nav=The Kitchen/Menu/Wines/The Market/Location; menu title='Our works of art "The Menu"'; tabs=To Share/Stews & Stocks/Fish & Meat/Jordi's Wild Ideas/Homemade Desserts/Wine List). Mobile hero-video-mobile slot correctly renders 2 <video> elements (double-buffer) both pointing to /videos/mobile/vN.mp4. New photos verified: torrezno hover-card shows /dishes/torrezno.webp; torrija & coulant have mobile inline images (menu-item-image-mobile-torrija/coulant) at /dishes/torrija.webp; bog-croquetes exists in Bogeries tab. Reserve drawer opens with CoverManager iframes. Only 1 console error (a 404 on a resource, unrelated to test scope) and no JS runtime errors.

issues: 6 hidden desktop hero <video> elements (from hero-video-slot-0/1/2 double buffers) remain in DOM on mobile viewport with preload='auto' and src pointing to heavy /videos/vN.mp4. They are visually hidden (offsetParent=null) but browser can still fetch them, partially defeating the mobile perf optimization. Consider conditionally not rendering the desktop grid on mobile (e.g., useMediaQuery) or setting preload='none' on the hidden variant.

action_items: Optional perf improvement: skip rendering desktop VideoSlot components when viewport is mobile (conditional render instead of CSS hide) so heavy /videos/vN.mp4 files aren't preloaded on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero uses responsive CSS hide (hidden md:grid / md:hidden) to switch between desktop and mobile video layouts, but both trees are mounted. On mobile the 6 desktop <video preload='auto'> still exist in DOM and may fetch bytes even when hidden — undermines the perf optimization behind /videos/mobile/. Prefer conditional mount via useMediaQuery.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 validated trilingual (CA/ES/EN), new dish photos (torrezno hover, torrija/coulant mobile img, bog-croquetes), mobile hero videos using /videos/mobile/ with double-buffer (2 video elements per slot), and reserve drawer. Only design note: hidden desktop hero videos still mount on mobile viewport with preload=auto — potential perf regression not required by original spec but worth addressing. Note per main agent's context: video playback errors (code 4) in Chromium headless are expected due to H.264 codec absence and are NOT bugs.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs to RCA; all requested behavior verified.
